summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for GreenHiveHR - a South African SaaS HR & Compliance Multi-Tenant platform featuring public marketing portal, multi-company HR practitioner dashboard, live Gemini-powered SA Labour Law assistant, CCMA-ready disciplinary toolkit, compliance tracking engine (BCEA, LRA, POPIA, COIDA, UIF, EE, B-BBEE), time tracking & billing, document vault, and employee self-service portal.
